FISHING LICENCE · COSTA RICA

Costa Rica fishing licence

Visitors need an INCOPESCA sport fishing card for boat fishing. The captain's or boat's licence does not replace each angler's card.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Domestic and foreign anglers fishing from a boat.
  • Underwater anglers need the applicable card.
  • INCOPESCA also lists a shore and kayak card category.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Boat fishing cardany8 days$16.95 USD
Boat fishing cardany30 days$28.25 USD
Boat fishing cardany1 year$56.50 USD

Saltwater

INCOPESCA's card requirements apply to both inland and marine fishing.

Fishing with a guide or charter

Each person who fishes aboard the boat must carry a sport fishing card. A tourist group can apply together.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the card.
  • Release marlin and sailfish in the water.

How to buy

Apply and pay through INCOPESCA's online card service with your identification or passport details.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Costa Rica?

Visitors need an INCOPESCA sport fishing card for boat fishing. The captain's or boat's licence does not replace each angler's card.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Costa Rica?

Boat fishing card: $16.95 USD; Boat fishing card: $28.25 USD; Boat fishing card: $56.50 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Costa Rica?

Apply and pay through INCOPESCA's online card service with your identification or passport details.
